newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Littoral to create subsidiary for charter act.
newsitem.headline: Air Littoral to create subsidiary for charter act.

text.p: French independent airline, Air Littoral, said it planned to create a subsidiary company later this year specialising in cargo and passenger charter activities.

"The subsidiary, to be named Air Littoral Express, is scheduled to begin its activities on April 1 1997 and is likely to be headed by Air Littoral's cargo director, Pierre Fourques," an airline official told Reuters.

"The creation of a subsidiary company is designed to promote the development of our charter activties and facilitate the pursuit of contracts such as that signed with United Parcel Service last year," he added.
In 1996, Air Littoral signed a one-year, renewable wet-lease agreement with United Parcel Service, covering cargo charter services.

Under the terms of the agreement, Montpellier-based Air Littoral operates five, two-tonne capacity, cargo-configurated, Beechcraft 1900 aircraft on behalf of UPS, a service launched in September 1996.

The aircraft undertake a programme of intra-France feeder flights operating between UPS' principal French hub at Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport and Rennes and Strasbourg and between Lyon-Satolas and Nice, Bordeaux and Toulouse.
The five feeders flights synchronise with UPS's Boeing 727F services between Paris/CDG and Cologne and Lyon-Satolas and Cologne.

Commenting on the UPS agreement, Fourques told Reuters: "It's a big step forward for us but we don't intend to stop there, our aim being to gain broad recognition as a charter operator for small, cargo-configurated aircraft."
Air Littoral's fleet inludes ATR42s and Embraer 120RT which are also available for cargo charter services being convertible from passenger mode.
Air Littoral is in the midst of renewing its fleet with 15 ATR42-500 passenger aircraft.
Air Littoral said it expected a turnover for the financial year ending March 31 1997 of 1.2 billion francs generating profits of 30 million francs.
Air Littoral recently created a subsidiary company, Air Littoral Assistance, specialising in airport ground services. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
